bearer.description: A signed token from Identity (API-01). The permission listed on each operation is checked on the server, then the optional feature; default-deny.

Reply.description: The reply. Its body schema is not yet declared for this endpoint.

TooManyRequests.description: Too many requests; wait for Retry-After.

NotFound.description: The record named in the path is not here.

Conflict.description: The Idempotency-Key was used for a different request, or the change conflicts with one recorded a moment ago.

Unreadable.description: The body could not be read as this request; nothing was saved.

Money.description: An amount in whole minor units (e.g. 1050 = ₹10.50) — never a float (packages/contracts/src/money.ts).

Quantity.description: A quantity in the unit's smallest step (e.g. 1234 = 1.234 kg) (packages/contracts/src/quantity.ts).

code.description: A stable machine code, e.g. permission_denied, idempotency_key_reused.

wasItSaved.description: "unknown" is honest: a timeout or a lost reply.

traceId.description: Correlates the reply with the audit trail; never business data.

OpenBody.description: A JSON object. This endpoint does not yet declare its body schema; the handler validates it and refuses an unreadable body with 400 and a reason.

DomainEvent.description: The §30.2 event envelope (packages/contracts/src/event.ts). Consumers dedupe on idempotencyKey (§31.1).

centre.description: A branch or department of the organisation (M23-FR-01); a centre it does not have is refused 422 unknown_centre.

netByDepartment.description: OB-340: each department's exact net on a sale or sale-return voucher.

centre.description: A branch or department of the organisation (M23-FR-01); a centre it does not have is refused 422 unknown_centre.

JournalRequest.description: Debits must equal credits; a closed month takes nothing (422 with the reason).

PurchaseOrderProposalRequest.description: A new order needs supplierId, deliverToLocationId and lines with a unit cost; a call-off release of a blanket agreement names blanketAgreementId and carries no price.

committedAt.description: ISO-8601 time the lane committed the sale (locally first — hard rule #1).

lineTotalMinor.description: What the lane charged for the line, AFTER its own discount.

kind.description: A tender kind (components/schemas/TenderKind lists the known ones).

card.description: The ONLY card facts a sale carries (hard rule #3): a provider token reference, the last four digits and the network — never the full card, its security code or its expiry.

SaleIntakeRequest.description: A sale as the lane committed it. Refused 400 not_readable_as_a_sale only when it cannot be read as one.

restockedLines.description: How many returned lines went back to sellable stock.

approvalId.description: The approval a second person gave in their own session (ADR-0022) — never a typed name.

SaleReturnRequest.description: Who processed it is the signed-in caller and the approval threshold is the shop's policy — neither is read from the body.

SupplierAdvanceApplicationRequest.description: Against a bill: { amountMinor, invoiceId, appliedOn }; to undo one: { reverses, amountMinor, appliedOn }.

approvalId.description: The supplier_payment approval a second person gave (§28).

advancesAppliedMinor.description: OB-341: what the supplier's advances had already settled.

balanceToPayMinor.description: OB-341: owed less advances, after this payment.

approvalId.description: The supplier_payment approval a second person gave (§28).

SupplierPaymentRequest.description: OB-341: refused 422 payment_exceeds_balance above what is owed LESS what advances already settled.
